_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.lead: Everyone thinks a designer tuned it
beats.note: In Space Invaders the aliens surge faster as you shoot them down. Nothing in the game's code speeds them up. Open the original ROM and that instruction simply isn't there.

beats.name: Tomohiro Nishikado
beats.role: Built the whole game almost single-handed for Taito, running on an Intel 8080. With 55 aliens to move, redraw and test for hits, the chip could barely keep pace.

beats.context: Every one is a sprite the processor must shift, draw and check each frame. At the start of a wave, all that work drags the whole screen slow.

beats.lead: Shoot one and the workload drops
beats.note: Each kill leaves the 8080 less to compute, so the survivors accelerate. The famous rising panic is the hardware exhaling, not a difficulty curve someone drew.

beats.text: The best mechanic in the game is a bug nobody wrote.

beats.line: The dread was just a chip catching its breath.
